0 HOT setups? 0 WARM setups? You gotta be kidding me. When was the last time we saw the board completely empty like this? Here's your cheat code: this is what the calm before the storm looks like. Think about it—when the opportunities contract, when the market takes a collective pause, it’s usually just the wind-up before the next big move. Don’t listen to the bears chirping about how this is the end. The market is telling us something. Are we listening?

Risk is on. Full stop. The $SPX has been clawing its way back to the highs, sector rotation is alive and well, and crypto’s still buzzing under the surface. Take a look at energy and uranium—those tickers are climbing like it’s 2021 all over again. We’ve got $UEC up 43% and $UUUU still flexing at +133% max. That’s leadership. Over in rare earth metals, $MP’s already doubled, and $UAMY is right there with it. These are structural themes, not fads. The market’s underpinnings are strong, even without any immediate squeeze setups lighting up.

And no surprises in crypto—$ETHA, $BLSH, $BMNR, and $SBET are staying sticky in the portfolio. $COIN’s already printed a double, but the way these names are behaving, I wouldn’t be shocked if there’s another leg higher. We’re also watching $NIO creeping up the China trade. Two entries on the board, +55% and +39%, and still holding full size. That’s telling us something.

For late entries, energy and uranium are obvious plays here. $OXY and $APA haven’t run away yet, and that whole space has a bid right now. $SE in software is snoozing a bit, up 22%, but here’s the deal: it’s still a full position, which means the story might not be written yet. Keep an eye on $SOUN and $RZLV in this sector too—small moves so far, but the setup is there if risk appetites spill over into tech.

What’s next? Today’s close matters. If we don’t see fresh breakouts by the weekend, I’d expect some consolidation into next week. But if something starts to catch fire—especially in uranium, rare earths, or energy—you know what to do. The playbook’s the same: ride the leaders, manage your risk, and trust what the market’s telling you. Right now, it’s telling us to be ready.
